repo_notes.content: Ashlr MD is a local-first Markdown desktop app. The React frontend is in src/, the Tauri/Rust backend is in src-tauri/, and editor integrations are in integrations/. Explain how these parts interact and ground claims in the current source.

The MCP tool registry and CLI help in src-tauri/bins/mdopener-mcp/src/ are authoritative for agent interfaces; frontend handlers are in src/mcp/handlers/. docs/AGENTS.md and llms-full.txt are maintained guides, not substitutes for checking source.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the local-first desktop architecture, repository layout, and communication between the React frontend and Tauri backend.

pages.title: Markdown Editing and Rendering
pages.purpose: Describe the editor, Markdown rendering pipeline, links, and application state in src/.

pages.title: Native Backend
pages.purpose: Explain the Tauri commands, filesystem operations, and platform-specific behavior in src-tauri/.

pages.title: Agent and CLI Interfaces
pages.purpose: Describe the mdopen and mdopener-mcp binaries, MCP tool registry, frontend bridge and handlers, and how agents interact with open documents.

pages.title: Editor Integrations
pages.purpose: Explain the VS Code, Obsidian, and Raycast integrations in integrations/ and how they launch or communicate with Ashlr MD.

pages.title: Development and Testing
pages.purpose: Describe setup, frontend and Rust tests, documentation freshness checks, and relevant maintenance scripts using CONTRIBUTING.md and the repository scripts.
